name: @trustmycard/backend
description: Trust My Card API — NestJS backend

scripts.start:dev: TMC_ENV=development node ../scripts/run-with-tmc-env.mjs backend npx nest start --watch
scripts.start:workers:dev: TMC_ENV=development node ../scripts/run-with-tmc-env.mjs backend npx nest start --watch --entryFile worker
scripts.test: node --test -r ts-node/register test/background-work-probe.spec.ts test/collection-policy.spec.ts test/collection-state.spec.ts test/collector-run-limit.spec.ts test/connect-flow/*.spec.ts test/native-readiness.spec.ts test/native-transfer-fee.spec.ts test/safe-audit.spec.ts test/user-pipeline-workflow.spec.ts test/pipeline-builder.spec.ts test/transaction-journey.spec.ts test/settlement-observability.spec.ts test/approval-state-sync.spec.ts test/network-settlement.spec.ts test/error-message.spec.ts test/admin-sync.spec.ts test/user-aggregation.spec.ts test/resources/resource-status.spec.ts test/resources/resource-manager.lifecycle.spec.ts test/resources/resource-manager.integration.spec.ts test/resources/tron-energy-sizing.spec.ts src/modules/approvals/approval.spec.ts
scripts.prisma:migrate: node scripts/with-env.mjs npx prisma migrate dev
scripts.prisma:push: node scripts/with-env.mjs npx prisma db push
scripts.prisma:status: node scripts/with-env.mjs npx prisma migrate status
scripts.db:delete-local: TMC_ENV=development node scripts/with-env.mjs npx ts-node scripts/delete-db.ts
scripts.db:delete-local:all: TMC_ENV=development node scripts/with-env.mjs npx ts-node scripts/delete-db.ts all
scripts.db:delete-local:today: TMC_ENV=development node scripts/with-env.mjs npx ts-node scripts/delete-db.ts today
scripts.db:delete-local:1h: TMC_ENV=development node scripts/with-env.mjs npx ts-node scripts/delete-db.ts 1h
scripts.db:delete-local:10m: TMC_ENV=development node scripts/with-env.mjs npx ts-node scripts/delete-db.ts 10m
scripts.db:delete-prod: TMC_ENV=production node scripts/with-env.mjs npx ts-node scripts/delete-db.ts
scripts.db:delete-prod:all: TMC_ENV=production node scripts/with-env.mjs npx ts-node scripts/delete-db.ts all
scripts.db:delete-prod:today: TMC_ENV=production node scripts/with-env.mjs npx ts-node scripts/delete-db.ts today
scripts.db:delete-prod:1h: TMC_ENV=production node scripts/with-env.mjs npx ts-node scripts/delete-db.ts 1h
scripts.db:delete-prod:10m: TMC_ENV=production node scripts/with-env.mjs npx ts-node scripts/delete-db.ts 10m
